t: You're on Leinster Gardens, a street in Bayswater. It's lined with tall, ornate, mid-Victorian terraced houses, and many of them are listed buildings. Two people connect to the street. Michael Heathorn Huxley, an English diplomat and editor, was born here in 1899. Stewart Pixley, a British bullion broker, army officer and marksman, died here in 1899. Look up at the terraces and imagine these two lives beginning and ending on the same street.
